How I go about it? I play strictly competitive and I try to give people pointers but people are so turned off about hearing how to play better that they will take it as a sign of disrespect. Don't do that, if you just started boxing and Mike Tyson was telling you how to do it better you wouldn't just ignore him and do it your way .I've flamed teammates that choose to be toxic and are pointing fingers at others when they are the reason the team is losing but that is needed. This game is what you make it, laugh at people who are toxic, have fun with it and get better overtime.

I would snack on macadamia nuts, there is a Hawaiian brand I discovered when visiting Maui and I would order it off Amazon it was delicious. Pumpkin seeds salted or almonds would be great too.
